result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving. However, it lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signal heads, and the cobblestone roadway surface presents an uneven terrain for those with mobility challenges.

hazards.name: Uneven Road Surface
hazards.description: The cobblestone pavement creates an uneven surface that is difficult for wheelchairs, strollers, and individuals with mobility impairments to navigate.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway area

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks reduces the visibility of the pedestrian crossing zone to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection crossing points

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular traffic lights, which do not provide specific walk/don't-walk intervals or countdowns.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps with tactile warning strips. The presence of tram tracks and uneven cobblestone paving introduces potential tripping and slipping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway can be slippery when wet and may catch bicycle tires or thin-heeled shoes.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway running parallel to the sidewalk

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the intersection may partially block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Uneven paving surface
hazards.description: The transition between asphalt and cobblestone pavers creates an uneven surface that could be a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing area

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and increase the visibility of people waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing markings to a high-visibility continental pattern to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, curb ramps with tactile warnings, and signalized crossings. However, the presence of embedded trolley tracks and uneven cobblestone pavement within the intersection creates potential trip hazards and accessibility challenges.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

hazards.name: Uneven Cobblestone Pavement
hazards.description: The transition to cobblestones creates an uneven surface that may be difficult for those with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Smooth Crossing Surface
interventions.description: Ensure the pedestrian path across the tracks and cobblestones is level and slip-resistant.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the presence of embedded trolley tracks and uneven cobblestone transitions introduces tripping hazards and complicates the crossing environment.

hazards.name: Embedded trolley tracks
hazards.description: Metal rails embedded in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create a tripping hazard or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the roadway and across the crosswalk area

hazards.name: Uneven pavement transitions
hazards.description: The transition between asphalt and cobblestone surfaces is uneven, increasing the risk of trips for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the edges of the crosswalk and near the tracks

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The continental-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pavement Leveling and Repair
interventions.description: Level the transitions between different paving materials to ensure a smooth, trip-free walking surface.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Watch for Trolley' warning signs to alert pedestrians to the specific rail hazard.
